items.q: What Simple Bake is and who it is for
items.short: An app for pastry makers and small bakeries: orders, customers, recipes and costing, inventory, documents and payment in one place.
On Android: “Simple Bake” in Google Play. Or use the web version in a browser: simple-bake.com → “Open”.
items.where:
You can add the web version to your home screen from the browser menu.
Android, Chrome: “⋮” → “Install app” (or “Add to Home screen”).
iPhone, Safari: “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”.
items.important: There is no App Store app yet; on iPhone use the web version.

items.short: Two ways: “Sign in with Google”, or e-mail and password (“Don't have an account? Sign up”).
items.where: Sign-in screen → “Sign in with Google”; or enter your e-mail and a password (at least 6 characters) → “Sign up”.
items.important: With e-mail you will get a confirmation message: you cannot sign in until the e-mail is confirmed. The message is currently in English; check “Spam”. With Google no confirmation is needed. If the e-mail is already registered, the app will suggest signing in or resetting the password.
items.plan: Any. Everything is open for the first 7 days

items.q: How to sign in and what to do if you forgot the password
items.short: On the sign-in screen enter your e-mail and password → “Sign in”.
items.where: Forgot the password: “Forgot password?” → enter your e-mail → “Send reset email” → follow the link in the message → “New password” (at least 6 characters, different from the old one) → “Save password”.
items.important: The link in the message can expire: then request a new one. Signing in with Google: choose the same Google account you signed up with.

items.q: First launch: “Welcome!” and the app tour
items.short: At first sign-in the app asks for your bakery name (you can change it later in settings) → “Get Started”. Then it offers “Take a quick tour?” — “Take the tour” or “Skip”.
items.important: If you did not load samples: Settings → “Load Demo Data” (only for an empty organization). After the first launch you get a welcome e-mail; replies go to support.

items.short: The language is chosen once at first launch from your phone language: if the app has it, it is used, otherwise English.
items.where: Settings → “Language” → pick a language: English, Русский, Lietuvių, Українська.
items.important: Lithuanian and Ukrainian are marked “Draft”: the translation has not yet been checked by a native speaker. There is no language choice on the sign-in screen. If your phone is set to Polish or German, the interface will be in English. The language of documents and e-mails to customers is chosen separately when sending.

items.q: E-mail did not arrive / how to contact support
items.short: Check “Spam”. The confirmation message is needed only when signing up with e-mail; the welcome message arrives once and does not affect your work.
items.important: If there is no message, sign up again with the correct e-mail or write to simplebake.support@gmail.com (you can reply to the welcome message).
